scripts.dev: npm run build -w @toeic/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start:dev -w @toeic/api" "npm run dev -w @toeic/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @toeic/shared && npm run build -w @toeic/api && npm run build -w @toeic/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @toeic/shared && npm run test -w @toeic/api && npm run test -w @toeic/web
